title: Identity type
description: Notion of equality in type theory
extract: In type theory, a branch of mathematics, the identity type represents the concept of equality. It is also known as propositional equality to differentiate it from "judgemental equality". Equality in type theory is a complex topic and has been the subject of research, such as the field of homotopy type theory.
